CHOSEN: preserving arbitrary unchecked return values would make a timestamp API dynamically typed and move failure into every consumer; this API instead requires a number. The typed number response boundary rejects non-number current data that the actual TypeScript getter returns unchanged; tests/public_reads.rs executes the actual method and ENDPOINTS declaration for 20 cases (14 numbers, six explicit refusals), each through encoded JSON, native untransformed and native transformed response bodies. Shared numeric ingress preserves negative zero, overflow, underflow and rounded integers. Shared HttpClient is injected in place of the xhr receiver; factory, constructor, retry, authentication and response interceptors remain separately pending. Existing HttpFailure is returned unchanged with code, request, response and context retained; three actual-source rejection witnesses and direct native metadata assertions. Decode refusals retain current response plus the method request, not a fabricated network cause. No prediction-core model or normalization is introduced. tests/public_reads_controls.py exercises URL, method, signed-zero and failure-metadata production controls plus source cardinality and guard removal.
